items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: So me an' him used to be up there every night, together, bangin' around on the...he be playin' the piano an' I be singin' the blues.

ctx.x: Art Tatum...I walked up to him and asked him, I say, 'You play so much piano,' so I asked him could he play any blues. He say, 'Yeah, can you sing 'em?' So me an' him used to be up there every night, together, bangin' around on the...he be playin' the piano an' I be singin' the blues.
